changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Register the Trino federated gateway as a copilot-ai datasource so Agent chat can resolve database 9 to an executable datasource.
changeSet.sql: WITH updated_source AS ( UPDATE copilot_ai.data_source SET db_type = 'trino', jdbc_url = 'jdbc:trino://${DTS_TRINO_HOST:dts-trino}:${DTS_TRINO_PORT:8080}/postgres/public', username = '${DTS_TRINO_USER:copilot}', password = '', status = 'ACTIVE', description = 'Trino federated gateway for PRS Agent BI schema lookup and cross-database query execution.', updated_at = ${now} WHERE lower(name) = lower('联邦查询入口') RETURNING id ), inserted_source AS ( INSERT INTO copilot_ai.data_source ( name, db_type, jdbc_url, username, password, status, description, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT '联邦查询入口', 'trino', 'jdbc:trino://${DTS_TRINO_HOST:dts-trino}:${DTS_TRINO_PORT:8080}/postgres/public', '${DTS_TRINO_USER:copilot}', '', 'ACTIVE', 'Trino federated gateway for PRS Agent BI schema lookup and cross-database query execution.', ${now}, ${now} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated_source) RETURNING id ), resolved_source AS ( SELECT id FROM updated_source UNION ALL SELECT id FROM inserted_source ) UPDATE copilot_analytics.analytics_database db SET details_json = ( COALESCE(NULLIF(db.details_json, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('copilotDataSourceId', (SELECT id FROM resolved_source LIMIT 1)) )::text, updated_at = ${now} WHERE lower(db.name) = lower('联邦查询入口');
